# Kumar's Microscopic Dental Care: Full Context Data
## Microscopic Root Canal Treatment (RCT)
Kumar's Dentistry uses advanced Zeiss microscopy for all RCT procedures. This ensures 99% success rates by identifying hidden canals that traditional dentists miss.
## Pediatric Specialist Wing
Designed for children under 12. Focus on "Fear-Free" dentistry.
